court: Suffolk County Court, Riverhead, New York
status: Pleaded guilty April 8, 2026, before Justice Timothy P. Mazzei to three counts of first-degree murder and four counts of second-degree murder, and was sentenced June 17, 2026, to three consecutive terms of life without parole plus a consecutive 100 years to life.
detail: The victims are Melissa Barthelemy, Maureen Brainard-Barnes, Amber Costello, Megan Waterman, Jessica Taylor, Sandra Costilla, and Valerie Mack; he also allocuted to the uncharged killing of Karen Vergata, which the plea covered. He waived his right to appeal on the record at the plea hearing. There is no upcoming court date in this case.

court: 24th Judicial District Court, Jefferson Parish, LA
status: Keller pleaded guilty to manslaughter in the shooting death of Taj Laurent Sr., 51, and was sentenced to 35 years on August 17, 2026.
detail: The Jefferson Parish District Attorney’s office says Keller admitted shooting his girlfriend’s father during a Christmas-night argument, and that the plea was entered as jury selection was beginning. The case is resolved and no further court date is expected.
source_label: Jefferson Parish District Attorney, plea and sentencing announcement (August 2026)

case: Asia Lozano Morton — Mark Calcagni case
court: Sonoma County Superior Court, Santa Rosa, CA
status: Morton was charged as an accessory after the fact in the Mark Calcagni case, not with the killing. She entered a no-contest plea in December 2025 and was sentenced on August 14, 2026 to a two-year split term: one year in Sonoma County jail followed by one year of supervision.
detail: Judge Lynnette Brown imposed the sentence. The separate murder prosecution of Richard Lund is calendared for trial on August 28, 2026 and is listed above.
